relevance_review.finding: gb12238 is a butterfly-valve standard and is not an appropriate supporting source for a gate-valve term.
ISO 5752 is explicitly for face-to-face and centre-to-face dimensions, while ASME B16.34 is not the primary dimensional standard for end-to-end dimensions.

notes: The main valve-type, component, actuation, material, testing and documentation translations are consistent with common valve-industry Chinese usage.
Technical distinctions such as Tilting Disc versus Swing Check, Backseat versus Backseat Test, and Face-to-face versus End-to-end are preserved.
No candidate was approved solely because it had high confidence; ambiguous matching and source relevance were reviewed independently.
Closure Member and Clapper are valid valve terms but are also generic or ambiguous English expressions; they must remain behind a reliable valve-context gate.

Fail Close and Fail Open are short data-sheet expressions. In the current runtime design, operator-category terms can themselves establish valve context, so context=valve alone does not fully prevent an ordinary-sentence false match.
The monitored compound terms have correct Chinese targets and are sufficiently specific when exact-boundary matching and valve context are both retained.
